kurals.tr: Yaadhanin Yaadhanin Neengiyaan Nodhal / Adhanin Adhanin Ilan
kurals.m: Whatever thing, a man has renounced, by that thing; he cannot suffer pain

kurals.tr: Ventin Un Taakath Thurakka / Thurandhapin Eentuiyar Paala Pala
kurals.m: After a man has renounced (all things), there will still be many things in this world (which he may enjoy); if he should desire them, let him, while it is time abandon (the world)

kurals.tr: Atalventum Aindhan Pulaththai Vitalventum / Ventiya Vellaam Orungu
kurals.m: Let the five senses be destroyed; and at the same time, let everything be abandoned that (the ascetic) has (formerly) desired

kurals.tr: Iyalpaakum Nonpirkondru Inmai Utaimai / Mayalaakum Matrum Peyarththu
kurals.m: To be altogether destitute is the proper condition of those who perform austerities; if they possess anything, it will change (their resolution) and bring them back to their confused state

kurals.tr: Matrum Thotarppaatu Evankol Pirapparukkal / Utraarkku Utampum Mikai
kurals.m: What means the addition of other things those who are attempting to cut off (future) births, when even their body is too much (for them)

kurals.tr: Yaan Enadhu Ennum Serukku / Aruppaan Vaanorkku Uyarndha Ulakam
kurals.m: Shall enter realms above the powers divine

kurals.tr: Patri Vitaaa Itumpaikal Patrinaip / Patri Vitaaa Thavarkku
kurals.m: Sorrows will never let go their hold of those who give not up their hold of desire

kurals.tr: Thalaippattaar Theerath Thurandhaar Mayangi / Valaippattaar Matrai Yavar
kurals.m: Those who have entirely renounced (all things and all desire) have obtained (absorption into God); all others wander in confusion, entangled in the net of (many) births

kurals.tr: Patratra Kanne Pirapparukkum Matru / Nilaiyaamai Kaanap Patum
kurals.m: At the moment in which desire has been abandoned, (other) births will be cut off; when that has not been done, instability will be seen

kurals.tr: Patruka Patratraan Patrinai Appatraip / Patruka Patru Vitarku
kurals.m: Desire the desire of Him who is without desire; in order to renounce desire, desire that desire
